The document is 7 pages and pages 5-7 are the 2019-2021 vintage's OTHER CAMPAIGN ACCOUNTS block - a 'Summary Page Other Campaign Accounts' (Column B headed 'Year to Date', a DIFFERENT table from the standard Summary Page) plus its own two itemized pages. That block is HELD OUT of totals and out of the contributions/expenditures lists. What it held: every cell of its lines 1-7 is a written '0' (both columns on lines 1-2), and both of its itemized pages carry the single word 'N/A' in the first Name cell with printed subtotals and grand totals of 0 - i.e. the filer declared no other campaign accounts. 'N/A' in a name cell is not a transaction and was not emitted as a row. Cover confirms the chunk file (AARON DEKEYZER, County Council, District 6, April 5 interim), except that the chunk file's date 2020-04-01 is the SIGNATURE date - correct. NEITHER amendment box is ticked, so is_amendment is honestly blank. Street address, phone, fax and email are black-barred on the cover. On Schedule A the black bar covers the ENTIRE Complete Mailing Address column for all 13 rows - every donor_city/donor_state is blank as 'redacted at source', never as 'filer left it empty'. Occupation/Employer survives the bar on all 13 rows and is captured verbatim, including the filer's two-line 'occupation then employer' convention. ONE HONEST DEFECT: row 9's Date Received reads '3/72/20' - an impossible day. The '7' matches this filer's own 7 in '3/7/20' and '3/27/20' (their 1 is a plain unflagged vertical stroke), and it re-read identically at 1200 dpi. Row order would suggest 3/12/20, but ordering is an inference, not a printed figure, so the date is left BLANK with needs_review=1 and the verbatim kept in the row note. Rows 10 and 11 are two DIFFERENT donors both first-named KAMI (ROAKE and ROMEIKE) on the same date - not a duplicate.
